likely_causes.cause: Compressor not actually running during a cool call
High indoor humidity lowering sensible split (context only)

homeowner_checks: Confirm call_y / Cool is active and outdoor unit is running
Clear leaves and debris from the outdoor coil
Replace the filter so the blower can move air
Wait for a sustained run before judging delta-T
call_pro_when: Compressor amps show running but supply stays close to return after a long cool call.
sources: docs/PLAN.md low delta-T and long_run rules
assumptions: Humidity-adjusted thresholds may arrive later; fixed thresholds used for now
